components.css: .ds-btn-primary { display: inline-block; background: #c7430f; color: #faf9f6; font-family: 'General Sans', 'Helvetica Neue', Arial, sans-serif; font-weight: 500; font-size: 1rem; line-height: 1; text-decoration: none; padding: 1.125rem 2.25rem; border-radius: 0; transition: background 0.25s cubic-bezier(0.16,1,0.3,1), transform 0.25s cubic-bezier(0.16,1,0.3,1); } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: #a0350a; transform: translateY(-2px); } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #c7430f; outline-offset: 3px; }

components.name: Text Link

narrative.overview: The category standard, played completely straight and finished to the level of Work & Co, Instrument, and MetaLab: a light, typography-led studio site where restraint reads as competence. The page persuades by craft, not devices — a business owner with a hard problem should feel they are already looking at precise work. Density is low; type is large and decisive; color is rationed so the single accent means something. The user explicitly rejected conceptual carriers; nothing on the surface may read as a costume. Warmth comes from editorial pacing and honest copy, not ornament.
keyCharacteristics: Warm paper ground, near-black ink, one ember accent used sparingly
Cabinet Grotesk Extrabold display over General Sans text; hairline dividers
One orchestrated entrance motion; everything else is quiet state feedback
No fabricated proof anywhere: no logos, stats, testimonials until real

rules.name: The One Fuse Rule
rules.body: Ember appears once per viewport region — the action, or the drawn line, or a hover emphasis — never several competing at once.

rules.name: The One Kicker Rule
rules.body: Exactly one tracked-uppercase label exists on the page (the hero kicker). Sections lead with headlines, not eyebrows.

dos: Do keep every claim on the page true today; absence beats filler (the Work section renders only when a case-study file exists).
Do keep contact@codefusesolutions.com findable within seconds from the first viewport.
Do give every interactive element hover and visible keyboard focus states.
Do honor prefers-reduced-motion by rendering the entrance fully settled.
donts: Don't use icon-card grids, hero metrics, section numbers, gradient text, glass-as-decoration, or monospace-as-technical-costume.
Don't introduce a second accent color or use Ember for decoration.
Don't let the site drift dark or conceptual — light, conventional, excellent is the commitment.
